# Support

Thanks for using AINative Studio IDE. Here's how to get help.

## Reporting bugs or requesting features

Please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/AINativeStudio-IDE/issues) for bug reports and feature requests. Before opening a new issue, take a moment to [search existing issues](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/AINativeStudio-IDE/issues?q=is%3Aissue) to see if your problem or request has already been reported — it helps us avoid duplicates and may get you a quicker answer.

When filing a bug, include:
- Your OS and version
- The AINative Studio version you're running
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Any relevant logs or error messages

## Usage questions

For general "how do I..." questions, you're welcome to [open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/AINativeStudio-IDE/issues) — tag it as a question. We don't currently have a separate Q&A forum for this repository, so Issues is the most reliable way to reach the maintainers.

The broader AINative community also hangs out on [Discord](https://discord.gg/paipalooza), which can be a good place for informal questions and discussion with other users.

## Documentation

- [ainative-studio/README.md](ainative-studio/README.md) for setup and development instructions
- [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/AINativeStudio-IDE/blob/main/ainative-studio/HOW_TO_CONTRIBUTE.md) for how to contribute
- [docs.ainative.studio](https://docs.ainative.studio) for broader AINative platform documentation

## Security issues

Please do **not** file regular GitHub Issues for security vulnerabilities. This repository does not yet have a dedicated `SECURITY.md` with a reporting process — until one exists, please reach out via [ainative.studio/contact](https://ainative.studio/contact) or email hello@ainative.studio to report a security concern responsibly.
